name: protected-panel-web
description: Cloudflare Worker runtime shell for the protected panel web surface.

scripts.build:staging: WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home node ../../scripts/run-worker-staging-build.mjs PANEL_APP_API_SHARED_SECRET SENTRY_DSN -- vite build
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm deploy:verify-config && node ../../scripts/run-wrangler-command.mjs deploy --config dist/protected_panel_web/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:verify-config:staging: node ../../scripts/verify-worker-deploy-config.mjs dist/protected_panel_web/wrangler.json SERVICE:APP_API=app-api-staging VAR:PANEL_RUNTIME_API_BASE_URL=https://app-api.internal VAR:SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=staging VAR_ABSENT:SENTRY_RELEASE ROUTE:campus-panel-staging.ayafeed.com
scripts.preview: pnpm build && WRANGLER_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.wrangler-home vite preview
scripts.test: pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:worker
